title: Bashar :: Dark Skies and Shining Stars - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: The transcript excerpt focuses on Bashar addressing questions about life lessons and universal resources. He emphasizes that while help is always available, no one will remove the core lessons individuals chose to experience on their life path, as these challenges are essential for learning. He explains that lessons must be learned organically without external interference. The discussion then shifts to the purpose of lifeless planets and celestial objects, which Bashar describes as repositories of resources and wisdom. He notes that extraterrestrial civilizations have no need to conquer Earth due to the abundance of resources throughout the universe.

qa_topics.question: Will help be given to us when we ask for it?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Help is always available, but no one will erase lessons you chose to learn on your life path, as the challenge itself teaches what you need to know.

qa_topics.question: What is the purpose of planets and objects without life?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Lifeless planets offer resources for discovery and use; trillions of times more resources exist in the universe than on Earth, eliminating any need for extraterrestrials to invade.

quotes.quote: You can ask for help and help will always be given. However, no one will help change what you chose to experience.
quotes.context: On seeking assistance and life lessons

quotes.quote: If you haven't yet learned the lesson, no one is going to make it easier for you to do so.
There are trillions and trillions of times more resources out in the universe than you have on your world.
No extraterrestrial ever has to come to Earth saying, 'We want your planet. We want to take you over.'
They're there for you to discover things. They're there for you to use whatever they have to offer.
